findings.citation_text: Beyond the conventional marker systems that utilize RGB cameras to read printed markers, recent research has explored more advanced hardware designs to achieve additional functionalities such as single-pixel imaging for privacy-preserving reading [73], leveraging the optical image stabilization module of a smartphone camera to reconstruct 3D images [74], utilizing the dual cameras on mobile devices for depth estimation [75], designing Moiré patterns for marker pose measurement [76, 77], using birefringent nature of retroreflective tags for accurate angular measurement [78, 79], and designing 3D markers [80] or LED beacons [81] for underwater navigation.
